Error.ns0:ErrorEnglishDesc: The request contains invalid information. For assistance, contact CRA's Special Elections and Returns Internet Filing Helpdesk toll-free (within Canada/United States) at 1-800-959-9236 or collect (outside Canada/United States) at 613-221-3232.
